name: McGill University
description: McGill University is a public research university in Montreal, Quebec, founded in 1821. It teaches in English and is known for medicine, law, science and engineering, with international students making up nearly 30% of its enrolment.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website); its MD, CM is on the Singapore Medical Council's list, and the campus has a Malaysian and Singaporean Students' Association.

programmes.name: Master of Engineering (MEng, non-thesis)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students; a 45-credit programme takes about 1.5 years. Not fixed: the rate rises each year. Compulsory fees and a computing lab fee included; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2026-27 international Master's Non-Thesis table (Student Accounts), 'newly admitted and enrolled as of Fall 2026' column: C$16,416.30 per term x 2 terms = 30 credits (C$1,094.42 per credit; 45-credit programme = 1.5 years at this rate). Not guaranteed: the same cohort's rate is raised each year (Fall 2025 entrants C$15,634.50 per term in the 2025-26 table, C$16,103.55 in the 2026-27 table), so cohortLocked is false and history rows are each year's own new-entrant figure. Compulsory = student society (Fall C$198.78 + Winter C$113.78) + student services/athletics (C$376.49 x 2) + admin (C$243.75 + C$182.40) + copyright (C$17.55 x 2) + IT (C$151.20 x 2) + PGSS dental C$276.52 + Computing Lab fee for MEng non-thesis C$256.58 (2024: C$244.22; 2025: C$249.10); international health insurance (C$1,212) excluded.

programmes.name: Master of Business Administration (Desautels)
programmes.summary: Programme total spread over 1.5 years (up to 16 months), at a per-credit rate fixed for your intake. Includes compulsory fees and a one-off C$3,000 study trip; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2026-27 MBA international table (Student Accounts), 'admitted and enrolled as of Fall 2026': C$6,781.26 per 3 credits = C$2,260.42 per credit, charged on a maximum of 48 credits (54-credit programme; 6-credit internship not billed) = C$108,500.16 total, divided by 1.5 years (McGill quotes the full-time MBA at up to 16 months). Per-credit rate fixed by admission cohort (the Fall 2025 column is unchanged between the 2025-26 and 2026-27 tables). Compulsory = 15-credit-term column: student society (C$198.78 + C$113.78) + student services/athletics (C$376.49 x 2) + admin (C$243.75 + C$182.40) + copyright (C$17.55 x 2) + IT (C$151.20 x 2) + PGSS dental C$276.52; international health insurance (C$1,212) excluded. One-off = International Study Trip in Year 1 (C$3,000, as stated on the table). 2024/2025 rows: that cohort's own table (C$6,406.26 and C$6,593.76 per 3 credits, same 48-credit basis).

programmes.name: Bachelor of Civil Law and Juris Doctor (BCL/JD)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students, fixed for the whole programme at your entry-year rate. Programme is 3 to 3.5 years. Compulsory fees included; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2026-27 international fees, 30 credits, by admission year; tuition guaranteed for the programme. McGill classes the BCL/JD as an undergraduate programme (listed with its international undergraduate rates) although most entrants hold a prior degree, so it is filed as graduate-entry here. Compulsory = society, student services, admin, copyright, IT and SSMU dental fees; international health insurance (C$1,212) excluded. Programme is 105 credits, typically 3-3.5 years.

programmes.name: Doctor of Medicine and Master of Surgery (MDCM)
programmes.summary: First-year tuition for international students, the heaviest year; Years 2 to 4 cost less. Rate fixed for the programme. Compulsory fees included; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: Student Accounts '2026-2027 Tuition Rates - International Undergraduate Students' (updated December 2025): MDCM tuition C$74,678.31 for students admitted Fall 2026, based on 63 credits in Year 1 (the heaviest year; McGill lists 50.5, 51 and 35.5 credits for Years 2-4, so later years cost less). Per-credit rate guaranteed for the programme. Compulsory = society C$779.50 + student services/athletics C$774.60 + admin C$651.89 + copyright C$55.05 + IT C$440.55 + SSMU dental C$150 (estimated by McGill at +3%); international health insurance (C$1,155) excluded. Graduate-entry MDCM is 4 years. 2025 history from the '2025-2026 Tuition Rates - International Undergraduate Students' PDF (updated November 2024): MDCM tuition C$69,339.06 for students admitted Fall 2025 (63 credits), compulsory C$2,823.52 on the same basis. No 2024 row: the 2024-25 rates PDF is no longer online and the MDCM web tables show each cohort at its current year of study (not Year 1), so no source states the Fall 2024 cohort's Year-1 figure.

Educational Psychology (Non-Thesis): General Educational Psychology, 48 credits, Department of Educational and Counselling Psychology, Faculty of Education (2026-27 Course Catalogue, coursecatalogue.mcgill.ca/en/graduate/education/ecp/psychology-non-thesis-med-general/). McGill's Psychology department offers only thesis MSc/PhD degrees, the M.A. Counselling Psychology (Non-Thesis) Professional/Internship is 'currently closed to admissions' and the M.A. Educational Psychology (Non-Thesis) is 'currently not offered' in the 2026-27 catalogue, so this M.Ed. is the taught psychology master's open to new students. The general Master's Non-Thesis table applies (only MBA/IMPM programmes have separate tables), so fees and 2024/2025 history are copied from the existing MA Economics (non-thesis) record.
